CheckTitle: TMS predefined tags should be configured
Description: Ensure that at least one predefined tag is configured in Tag Management Service to support consistent resource classification.
Risk: Without predefined tags, users must enter tag keys and values manually, increasing the risk of inconsistent resource classification and cost allocation.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console
2. Navigate to Tag Management Service
3. Choose Predefined Tags
4. Create the required tag keys and values

Recommendation.Text: Define predefined tags such as environment, owner, or project in Tag Management Service to standardize resource classification.
